messages:
omar-finance: Heads-up - GCP Marketplace settlement for project gcp-ch-334 shows a negative adjustment of -$4,560 labeled 'Reseller Fee Recalculation'. No partner id on the line.
nina-partner-ops: Do we have the settlement id? GCP usually includes reseller id in the payout CSV.
ogp-marketplace-bot: Settlement notice: gcp-settle-2024-11-05 applied to order gcp-ord-334 on 2024-11-05T08:23Z. Adjustment: -4560.00 USD. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/settlements/gcp-settle-2024-11-05 (login required).
omar-finance: Link attached in billing UI. It references reseller adjustment but just says 'partner recalculation'. Could be CP-23 (SummitChannels) or CP-47.
rachael-arpayables: Important: if this reduces what GCP pays us, we shouldn't post as customer credit. We need to determine GL treatment: contra-revenue or reduction to COGS?
nina-partner-ops: I checked our partner ledger: gcp-ord-334 was originally routed through CP-23 (SummitChannels). I'll ping their rep and ask for confirmation.
vince-revenueops: For revenue recognition: if this pertains to usage from Sep 2024, we generally book adjustment in the period the correction is issued. But confirm materiality and whether it relates to previously recognized revenue.
rachael-arpayables: Draft JE if we book as contra-revenue: DR GCP Expense 6020 $4,560, CR Revenue (contra) 4001 $4,560. Leave memo: GCP reseller recalculation gcp-settle-2024-11-05.
inar-partner-ops: (typo) Nina: pinged SummitChannels rep, copied GCP PM. Rep says they accepted a surcharge rollback related to promo rate change and asked GCP to issue a credit. They expect docs in 2 business days.
omar-finance: Action items: (1) Nina confirm partner acceptance & get written confirmation; (2) Rachael prepare JE as draft and hold until partner confirm; (3) Vince to advise on period attribution once docs are received.
vince-revenueops: Marking as provisional contra-revenue for Nov close until final confirmation. Update forecast model.
rachael-arpayables: Will prepare accrual and tag as 'pending partner docs'.
nina-partner-ops: SummitChannels replied with their acceptance and attached their email thread. Pasting snippet: "we confirm the promo rollback and accept the resulting reseller adjustment."
omar-finance: Thanks. Rachael, can you post the JE once you have the written acceptance? We'll route to Finance Lead for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
gcp-marketplace-bot: Reminder: settlement CSV available for download at https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/settlements/csv/gcp-settle-2024-11-05.csv
